integrity: Analytical proof and reproducible finite-generator and symbolic consistency tests; numerical tests do not certify weak limits, historical uniqueness, or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive transmission and permanent hub immigration parameters at spectral-scale infection, homogeneous star graphs, stationary laws only. No absorbing-process extinction or quasistationary claims and no quantitative finite-size error rate. Full text of a closely related exact-star-SIS paper was inaccessible; historical priority remains uncertain.
title: Spectral-scale stationary fluctuations of hub-seeded SIS dynamics on stars
